{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: To All The Girls...; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rootsy sound appeals to me, but I am more interested in guitar-driven music today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotic Eye; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: You Should Be So Lucky has me interested in more music connected to Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers; I would choose this.
ItemID: NA; Title: Down Where the Spirit Meets the Bone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The bluesy roots-rock direction interests me, but I would save it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Rubber Soul; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Classic melodic rock fits my taste, but I am looking for something less familiar this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Complete Studio Albums Collection; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist name, I cannot tell whether this collection interests me.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I enjoyed Old Sock, and Clapton playing JJ Cale material feels like a natural next choice.
ItemID: NA; Title: Tour De Force: Live In London - Royal Albert Hall; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Live blues guitar appeals to me, but I would choose a studio album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blues Deluxe; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues-guitar focus fits my recent listening, but my other choices interest me more right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Lovin' Spoonful - Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not in the mood for a lighter oldies compilation today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Goin' Home; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues-focused guitar music fits my interest in Hendrix and Clapton, but I would leave this for later."}
